column_description: CHAR(10) primary key uniquely identifying each data flow record in the DataFlow table.
TIMESTAMP(6) for the moment this data flow record was created or logged. Microsecond precision.
A short identifier or tag (VARCHAR(20)) for the data flow, previously 'DataFlowID'.
VARCHAR(80) storing the source/origin country's name for this data flow.
VARCHAR(80) storing the destination country's name for this data flow.
VARCHAR(150) referencing the source entity/system initiating the flow (person, organization, or app).
VARCHAR(150) referencing the destination entity/system receiving the flow.
VARCHAR(30) for the protocol used (HTTP, FTP, SFTP, etc.). Currently possible values: (Blockchain, SFTP, Private Network, HTTPS).
VARCHAR(25) specifying how frequently data is transferred (daily, weekly, on-demand, etc.). Currently possible values: (Weekly, Hourly, Real-time, Daily).
NUMERIC(12,2) representing the size in MB of each data transfer.
SMALLINT capturing the average or actual duration (in minutes) of the data flow.
NUMERIC(5,2) for bandwidth utilization percentage (0 to 100%).
NUMERIC(5,2) measuring the success rate (0–100%) of the flow attempts.
SMALLINT counting the total errors or failures observed for this data flow.
SMALLINT storing how many retry attempts were made after failures.
